title: Origins: Necromancer
description: Raise the dead, harvest souls, and cheat death.
body:
# Origins: Necromancer

An origin addon for [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) that adds a fully custom
Necromancer origin with a soul-based resource system, minion summoning, and necrotic spellcasting.

---

## Soul System

Whenever any entity dies within 8 blocks of you, its soul is absorbed. Collected souls orbit
you visibly as particles and passively restore 0.5 hearts per minute each. At 5 souls the
Death Shield becomes available.

**Death Shield:** When you would otherwise die, all 5 souls are consumed. Nearby enemies are
knocked back, damaged, and slowed. You are briefly granted full damage immunity and a speed
boost. Afterward, Soul Rift begins.

**Soul Rift:** A 5-minute penalty state that follows every Death Shield activation. During it
you cannot collect souls, cannot summon minions, and take damage from direct sunlight without
a helmet. To end it early, stand still with empty hands and right-click to begin a 60-second
Soul Mend ritual. If the ritual is interrupted, Soul Rift resets and begins again without
the initial effects.

---

## Active Abilities

**Necrotic Burst** (primary key)
Releases a cone of necrotic energy 15 blocks long at a 30-degree spread. Deals 6 magic damage
and applies Slowness II and Weakness I for 4 seconds to all targets caught in the cone.
Costs 2 souls. Cooldown: 40 seconds.

**Circle of Death** (secondary key)
Projects a necrotic detonation point up to 20 blocks away. After a short windup, it explodes
in an 8-block radius for 10 magic damage. Your own minions are immune to the blast.
Costs 2 souls. Cooldown: 1 minute.

**Risen Dead** (passive, right-click)
Right-click the ground while holding Rotten Flesh to raise a zombie, or Bone to raise a
skeleton. The ritual takes 1.5 seconds and is interrupted if you move. Up to 3 minions can
be active at once. Each living minion reduces your maximum health by 2 hearts. Minions last
30 minutes before dispersing. Cannot be used during Soul Rift. Costs 1 soul. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

---

## Passive Traits

**Fragile Flesh**
Your maximum health is reduced by heart as a base penalty, separate from minion costs.

**Undead Aura**
Undead mobs within 16 blocks receive Strength I and will not target you.

**Wither Resistance**
The Wither status effect deals no damage to you.

**Ravenous**
All exhaustion from physical activity is increased by 50%.

**Slow Regeneration**
Natural health regeneration ticks half as often as normal.

**Undead Curse**
Enemies wielding a Smite-enchanted weapon deal 15% increased damage to you per enchantment
level. A Smite V sword hits you for 75% more damage than it otherwise would.

**Outcast**
Villagers flee from you on approach and refuse to trade.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.x with Fabric
- [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins)
- [Apoli](https://github.com/apace100/apoli/releases/tag/2.9.2%2Bmc.1.20.1)
